name: AW Browser
description: AW Browser as a Tier-2 (container) app: a Chromium instance from OUR prebuilt image (ghcr.io/tekflox/aw-browser, built by this repo's container/ + .github/workflows/build.yml, ported from the legacy monolith tools/browser/), started with --shm-size=1g. The container runs Chromium on Xvfb :99, exposes an interactive screen over noVNC on port 7900 (x11vnc:5900 → noVNC/websockify:7900) AND a CDP remote-debugging endpoint on 9223 (for Playwright/automation, reachable in-workspace as aw-app-browser:9223). runtime.port is the noVNC screen (7900) so the app's window + reverse-proxy surface the interactive browser the user can see and click; CDP stays on 9223 for automation. Unlike the generic browserless image, ours carries the AW container flags, the CDP platform-override fingerprint daemon, and the Microsoft-core-font set, and is wired to tunnel through AW's cookie proxy and accept the aw-sync extensions. The aw-workspace runtime spawns the container over the host's rootless podman socket and reverse-proxies it at /api/apps/browser/* (noVNC screen + WS). Supersedes the fragile Tier-1 in-process prototype (kept in reference/).

apps.reason: Authentication — this container's Chrome must tunnel through aw-app-proxy's CONNECT proxy, and aw-app-proxy injects/clears its cookies via CDP so it's logged in as the user. See tekflox/aw-app-proxy README.

dependencies.note: Declared for documentation — src/apps/ has no dependency-resolution/enforcement mechanism as of 2026-07-28 (see tekflox/aw-app-proxy README); does not block or auto-install anything yet.
